An incomplete Roman silver finger ring dating to the period c. AD 100-300, of Henig Type VIII. The ring comprises the bezel and the shoulders, but is missing most of the band. The raised bezel is oval in plan and exhibits one single central pellet. The shoulders are sub-triangular in plan and exhibit a line of stamped circular pellets running parallel to each outer edge.
